summary.text: Joseph Cardinale is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Kwani O'Pharrow (Democratic).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired NYPD lieutenant commander and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Cardinale was born in New York City and earned a high school diploma from St. John's Preparatory School.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes law enforcement, work as a mechanic, private investigator, truck driver and small business owner.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Brooklyn, moved to Long Island in 1994 and is a father and grandfather.
Cardinale ran for the same Assembly seat in 2024 and lost the general election to Kwani O'Pharrow, 49.2% to 50.8%.

In his 2026 survey, he said he wants to bring a more bipartisan approach to legislation and keep Long Island safe and affordable, and he named public safety and affordability as his main policy interests.
